kind: local static disassembly review; not a PIN execution trace
slices: i386+x86_64; address ranges refer to thin x86_64 derived slice
observations: C_Login passes original PIN pointer and raw byte count into login wrapper. Wrapper calls 0xa9bdb with that pointer/count.
0xa9bdb selects CKM_SHA_1 (0x220), hashes raw bytes, allocates 24 bytes, writes byte-swapped 32-bit raw length at offset20.
0x963ca obtains an 8-byte challenge, encrypts using caller 24-byte key and zero IV via 0x8ee7a, constructs 00 82 01 (0x80|kid) Lc8.
0x8ee7a selects the 24-byte 3-key DES schedule and CBC encrypt mode; implementation has 8-byte XOR/encrypt chaining.
test_choice: Use native OpenSC epass2003 external-key challenge authentication with vendor-verified raw PIN transform, kid1; exactly one attempt. No fallback to 24-byte direct-auth route.
limitations: Indirect C_Login vtable binding to the challenge route was not dynamically observed. EFY module also contains a direct 24-byte external-auth wrapper at0x9b148. The test checks challenge-route compatibility on the actual EFY card.
REA Hopper cleanup_incomplete prevented a native session. LLVM disassembly of the same local artifact used instead.
No PIN, derived key, cryptogram or secure-messaging key is recorded.
